attempts.summary: Configured tagged VLAN 10 (node2) and VLAN 20 (node3) over the shared physical link (node1 eth1 / node2,node3 enp8s0), with node1 as the 802.1q-tagging router providing per-VLAN gateways (192.168.10.1, 192.168.20.1). Verified real 802.1Q tagging on the wire, confirmed each host reaches node1 on its own VLAN, and confirmed node1's fw4 firewall (separate zones, no forwarding rule between vlan10/vlan20) explicitly REJECTs cross-VLAN traffic between node2 and node3. Performed the mandatory sequential restart protocol on all three nodes with changed boot_id proof and post-restart functional/isolation verification.
